## About
Regan's Service Inc. is an independently operated auto shop at 2066 Commonwealth Ave in Auburndale. We work on foreign and domestic cars, from classics to newer models, and we put safety first, for you, your family and everyone else on the road.
All our technicians are ASE certified and keep training to stay current with today's technology. We'd rather explain what your car actually needs than sell you what it doesn't. One customer told us the dealer had a long list, and we found it needed a battery and brakes.
A good deal of our work comes from neighbors sending their friends our way, and we're thankful for that. One reviewer mentioned we're handy to the cafes and Star Market, so you can grab a coffee while you wait.

## Services
- Diagnostics: We combine experience with good diagnostic tools to track down what's wrong and fix it.
- Inspections: Bring your car by for its inspection.
- Repairs and maintenance: As a full-service shop, we handle repair and maintenance work of all kinds.
- Brakes: We check your brakes and tell you straight what needs work and what's fine.
- Tires and alignments: We carry a wide range of tires and handle the alignment so they last.
- Pick up and drop off: Ask us and we can pick up and drop off your car.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How long does an inspection take?
A: One reviewer said the inspection and paying took 15 minutes total, and it cost $35.

Q: Do you give core refunds on parts and batteries?
A: Yes. We provide core refunds for parts and batteries.
